newsitem.title: CANADA: Southam could be keen on Ontario paper.
newsitem.headline: Southam could be keen on Ontario paper.

text.p: Southam Inc could be interested in the London Free Press newspaper, which the privately held Blackburn Group said it was looking to sell, Southam associate chief executive David Radler said on Wednesday.

The Blackburn family has owned the London, Ontario newspaper for 148 years. It said today it wanted to shed the paper as well as its CFPL-AM and CFPL-FM radio stations and its Netmar weekly shopper publication chain.
Analysts have said that Southam was the paper's logical buyer. "I think we are interested," Radler told Reuters in a telephone interview.
